subject.title: Session modelOverride persists across gateway restarts, silently overrides config default

question: Should explicit user-set `modelOverride`/`providerOverride` survive gateway restart and `/new`/`/reset`, or should OpenClaw add a reset/reconcile path that clears them by default or on explicit command?
rationale: Current main already documents and tests durable explicit pins, while the requested automatic clearing or bulk reset changes persisted session/provider routing semantics for existing users.

options.title: Preserve pins, add explicit reset tooling
options.body: Keep explicit pins durable, but add a scoped dry-run reset/reconcile command and keep `/status` visibility as the default recovery path.

options.title: Clear pins on new sessions
options.body: Change `/new` and `/reset` to drop model/provider overrides and add upgrade-focused tests and docs for the new default-inheritance behavior.

options.title: Fold into shared resolver work
options.body: Resolve this through the open shared session model/auth resolver effort so display, run selection, and reset semantics change together.

recommendation.title: Preserve pins, add explicit reset tooling
recommendation.body: Keep explicit pins durable, but add a scoped dry-run reset/reconcile command and keep `/status` visibility as the default recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the reset helper, gateway reset path, status warning, and model docs for this behavior.
